title: Maharashtra SSC Time Table 2027 Out: Class 10 Exams From February 15, Last Paper March 15 - Aakash

 The wait is over for Class 10 students in Maharashtra. MSBSHSE has released the Maharashtra SSC Time Table 2027, and written exams will run from February 15 to March 15, 2027. The date sheet went live on mahahsscboard.in on November 7, 2026. The Maharashtra board exam time table 2027 covers all nine divisional boards — Pune, Mumbai, Nagpur, Nashik, Kolhapur, Amravati, Latur, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar and Konkan.

 In this article Maharashtra SSC Time Table 2027 Live Update
 The Maharashtra State Board of Secondary and Higher Secondary Education (MSBSHSE) put out the Maharashtra SSC Time Table 2027 on November 7, 2026 . Written papers run from February 15 to March 15, 2027, and the PDF is up on mahahsscboard.in under Latest Notifications.
 First Language papers open the schedule on Monday, February 15. Geography wraps it up on Monday, March 15. Practicals, oral tests and internal assessments are between January 28 and February 13, 2027 — all before the written papers begin.
 Maharashtra SSC Time Table 2027: Subject-Wise Exam Dates
 Morning papers start at 11:00 AM. February 15 also has an evening paper at 3:00 PM for German and French. Here is the full 10th SSC board exam time table 2027 from the board PDF:
 Date Day Subject Shift 
 February 15, 2027 Monday First Language (Marathi, Hindi, Urdu, Gujarati, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Sindhi, Bengali, Punjabi) Morning 
 February 15, 2027 Monday German, French Evening 
 February 16, 2027 Tuesday Vocational subjects Morning 
 February 18, 2027 Thursday Second/Third Language (Marathi, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Sindhi, Bengali, Punjabi; Marathi Composite) Morning 
 February 20, 2027 Saturday Second/Third Language (Urdu, Gujarati, Sanskrit, Pali, Ardhamagadhi, Persian, Arabic, Avesta, Pahlavi, Russian) Morning 
 February 22, 2027 Monday First Language English; Third Language English Morning 
 February 24, 2027 Wednesday Second/Third Language Hindi; Hindi Composite Morning 
 February 26, 2027 Friday Second/Third Language Composite Course Morning 
 March 2, 2027 Tuesday Mathematics Part I (Algebra) Morning 
 March 4, 2027 Thursday Mathematics Part II (Geometry) Morning 
 March 8, 2027 Monday Science and Technology Part I Morning 
 March 11, 2027 Thursday Science and Technology Part II Morning 
 March 13, 2027 Saturday Social Sciences Paper I (History and Political Science) Morning 
 March 15, 2027 Monday Social Sciences Paper II (Geography) Morning 
 PwD candidates have Arithmetic on March 2 and Physiology, Hygiene and Home Science on March 8 in place of the regular Mathematics and Science papers.
 The Maharashtra SSC Time Table 2027 English Paper — First Language English and Third Language English — falls on February 22. Hindi follows on February 24 and the Composite Course on February 26. Then there are three days off before Mathematics Part I on March 2.
 Maharashtra SSC Time Table 2027 Pdf Download Link 
 How to Download Maharashtra SSC Time Table 2027 PDF?
 Open the MSBSHSE notifications page on mahahsscboard.in.
 Find the mahahsscboard.in SSC time table notice. Its title reads “ Time Table - Secondary School Certificate Examination Feb-March 2027 (Std. 10th - SSC) ” and it’s dated 07/11/2026.
 Hit the PDF icon. The 10th SSC board exam time table 2027 opens.
 Save it. No login needed — the SSC time table 2027 Maharashtra Board PDF download is open to everyone.
